key_fiscal_facts.value_text: Not a PSC — ADNOC concession model. IOC pays 40% WI share of costs (ADNOC 60%). No separate cost recovery mechanism; costs are pro-rata WI obligation. CAPEX recovered via depreciation in CIT base.

55% Petroleum Corporate Income Tax (Abu Dhabi Emirate Decree) on IOC upstream petroleum profits. Separate from 9% federal UAE CIT (June 2023) which explicitly exempts extractive companies. Some older concessions may have rates stabilized at signing.
N/A — UAE uses concession/JV structure (ADNOC holds 60%+ equity). Profit oil concept does not apply; IOCs hold equity stakes, not profit oil entitlements.
20% of gross revenue (Abu Dhabi; increased from 16% in 2024)

ADNOC holds 60% equity in all upstream concessions (mandatory Abu Dhabi policy). 2018 renewals ADCO (onshore): TotalEnergies 10%, BP 10%, Shell 6%, ExxonMobil 4%, CEFC 4%, INPEX 5%, Eni 5%, GS Energy 3%, ONGC 3%. ADMA-OPCO (offshore): ADNOC 60%, TotalEnergies 13%, BP 14.67%, JODCO 12.33%.
